text: Assumption: Because Ea_Read operates asynchronously and the data is transferred into Data Buffer Ptr only after function return, the buffer shall be kept valid until job termination — is this correct?
text_en: Assumption: Because Ea_Read operates asynchronously and the data is transferred into Data Buffer Ptr only after function return, the buffer shall be kept valid until job termination — is this correct?
norm: because ea_read operates asynchronously and the data is transferred into data buffer ptr only after function return the buffer shall be kept valid until job termination
assumption: Because Ea_Read operates asynchronously and the data is transferred into Data Buffer Ptr only after function return, the buffer shall be kept valid until job termination.
rationale: The specification describes the asynchronous acceptance via E_OK, but makes no explicit statement regarding buffer retention by the caller.

original.text: Annahme: Pufferlebensdauer: Da Ea_Read asynchron arbeitet und die Daten erst nach Funktionsrückkehr in Data Buffer Ptr übertragen werden, dürfte der Puffer bis zum Auftragsende gültig gehalten werden müssen — trifft das zu?

original.rationale: Die Spezifikation beschreibt die asynchrone Annahme via E_OK, trifft jedoch keine explizite Aussage zur Pufferhaltung durch den Aufrufer.
